excerpt: We offer a simple API to get transcription from your audios and videos, in both Real-time and asynchronous ways
Use the power of LLMs directly on your audios without a third party service.
If you want to build fast with Gladia, you can use one of our integration partners
Zapier For no-code automation ... Make For no-code automation ... n8n For workflow automation
Twilio To use Gladia with telephony
Playground: Test Gladia models and features in the browser before you integrate
GladiaFlow: Real-time voice dictation for your desktop.
Export subtitles (SRT/VTT): Generate caption files directly from transcripts
PII Redaction: Automatically detect and redact personally identifiable information in pre-recorded transcripts
Custom spelling: Normalize spelling variants to your preferred forms
Configure silence thresholds and maximum utterance duration in Gladia live transcription.
Configure Gladia to transcribe audio that switches languages. Use an explicit language list
Sentiment and Emotion Analysis: Extract sentiments and emotions from the transcript.
Pick a model with `model` in your request. Omit it to use the default: **`solaria-1`**.
Default generalist. 100+ languages, async and live, code switching.
Pass in a local file, binary data, or a remote URL — and let the method handle the rest.
custom_vocabulary_config: { vocabulary: ["Gladia", "Solaria", "Salesforce"] }
Translation: translate the transcript into one of our 100 target languages.
Speaker diarization: separate the speakers across the conversation
The init call returns a connectable URL and a session `id` that you can safely pass to web, iOS, or Android clients without exposing credentials
the session created by the init call lets the client reconnect without losing context.
Partial transcripts are provisional; final transcripts complete an utterance.
One command: install, set your key, run `gladia transcribe audio.mp3`
Flexible output: plain text, JSON, SRT, or VTT to stdout
Pipe-friendly: machine-readable output for scripts and CI
`completion <shell>` | Generate shell tab completion (bash, zsh, fish, powershell)
Top up credits, pay only for the audio you process... Start with 50€ free.
Upload your audio, vote on transcripts with model names hidden, and see which one you picked
end-to-end audio infrastructure to record, transcribe and enrich audio through a single API — with precise key entity capture, true multilingual support and 100% EU data residency
